description: Replies to an idea, criticism or comment on Veritula by its number, as the person who connected the app and marked as written with AI. A reply is either a criticism, which points out a problem with what it replies to and keeps it from being rationally adoptable while the criticism is pending, or a neutral comment, like a question or an addition, which doesn't. The content is Markdown. Posting takes signing in, and new accounts can post a few ideas a day.

criticism.description: Whether the reply is a criticism (true) or a neutral comment (false)

id.description: The number of the idea to reply to

name: reply
title: Reply to an idea
